1.text: Zaburi yo gushima.Mwa bari mu isi yose mwe,Muvugirize Uwiteka impundu,

2.text: Mukorere Uwiteka munezerewe,Muze mu maso ye muririmba.

3.text: Mumenye yuko Uwiteka ari we Mana,Ni we waturemye natwe turi abe,Turi ubwoko bwe,Turi intama zo mu cyanya cye.

4.text: Mwinjire mu marembo ye mushima,No mu bikari bye muhimbaza,Mumushime, musingize izina rye.

5.text: Kuko Uwiteka ari mwiza, 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Yer 33.11Imbabazi ze zihoraho iteka ryose,Umurava we uhoraho ibihe byose.
